title: Harlem Nights
tagline: The best club in Harlem. The best table in the house.
about: A nightclub owner and his adopted son outfox a crooked cop and a mob boss in 1930s Harlem.
cue: Serve the drinks when Jack Jenkins steps into the ring against Kirkpatrick.
faces: The best club in Harlem. The best table in the house.
